cardOverview.overviewText: An invite-only ultra-premium Emeralde Private card offering personalized concierge, luxury travel privileges, milestone rewards, and elite lifestyle benefits.
cardOverview.bestSuited: Experience, Travel Booking, Hotel Transfer, Pay by Points

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.offer: Buy 1 ticket and get upto ₹750 off on the 2nd Ticket.|spend ₹25,000 in the preceding calendar quarter to unlock the quota for the current quarter.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the BookMyShow website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.
benefitRows.exclusion: Can be availed twice a month.

benefitRows.name: Concierge
benefitRows.offer: Restaurant referral and reservation, flower and gift assistance, flight referral and reservation, hotel referral and reservation, car rental and limousine service, booking and delivery of movie tickets*, medical concierge privileges**, and emergency auto assistance across India.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Contact i-Assist, 24x7 concierge service at 1800-26-70731 (toll free for MTNL/BSNL lines) or 022-67872016 (standard call charges applicable).
